communications.communication:
Dear United States Space Force:

This is a request for records under the Freedom of Information Act.

RECORDS REQUESTED:

Please produce all records related to the Cape Canaveral Space Force Museum's mascot, Rupert the Space Armadillo.

Specifically, I request the following records:

1. Please produce all records related to the conception, creation, and design of the Rupert mascot. Please include any contracts or design concepts (e.g. sketches) in your production, as well as any records related to the Space Force's decision to create a mascot in the first place.

2. If any image of Rupert was created using AI, please produce all AI prompts that were used in the course of creating the image. Please also produce all AI image results that were generated but not ultimately used.

3. Please produce all Rupert-related promotional items, educational items, or tchotchkes, that took the form of records, such as trading cards, posters, videos, worksheets, or books (including but not limited to coloring books, activity books, or comic books).

4. Please produce all records related to the conception, creation, design, and use of any wearable Rupert costume. Responsive records would include contracts for the design or production of such a costume; design proposals or sketches; correspondence with the designer or manufacturer; and any guidelines related to the use of or care for the costume.

5. Please produce all records related to the conception, creation, design, and use of the Rupert stuffed animal. (See photos in the attached artice.) Responsive records would include contracts for the design or production of the stuffed animal, design proposals or sketches; correspondence with the designer or manufacturer; and any guidelines related to the use of or care for the stuffed animal.

6. Please produce all communications related to Rupert. This includes internal agency communications, as well as communications sent to or received from non-Space Force people, agencies, or entities (public or private).

7. Please produce any plans or guidelines for how the Rupert mascot will be used.

8. Please produce all documents in which the Coalie mascot appears, including electronic records such as social media posts.

9. Please produce all documents related to the creation or use of the Rupert logo. (See attached article.)

REQUEST FOR FEE WAIVER:

The requested documents will be made available to the general public online for free, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes. I am working on a project examining the history, creation, evolution, and use of mascots across the federal government—because, like many others, I find them fascinating and weirdly delightful. Thus, I respectfully request that any fees related to this request be waived. If you do decide to charge me fees, please notify me in advance if you expect those fees to exceed $25.

CONCLUSION

Thank you for your prompt attention to and processing of this request.

title: Fox Request #2 (Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

I have several related queries about Fox grantees that provide non-emergency clinical care.

(a) When a Fox grantee identifies a veteran, provides emergency clinical care, and then follows up with non-emergency mental health or substance use disorder services, how does VA verify whether those follow-up services are billed to or paid through the Community Care Network? Please provide records of VA’s audits of such.

(b) When a Fox grantee identifies a veteran who needs only non-emergency clinical care and provides it, how does VA verify whether that care is billed to or paid through the Community Care Network? Please provide records of VA’s audits of such.

(c) In the past two years, how many times has VA paid, through the Community Care Network, for non-emergency mental health or substance use disorder care delivered by Fox grantees, and what was the total amount paid? Please provide records of VA’s audits of such.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jasper Craven
